correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration by two independent face-generation algorithms gives 15,292 augmented independent faces and ordinary f-vector (30,297,1311,3054,4212,3639,1974,648,117,9). Every pivot pair and all 79,812 Hasse incidences are reconstructed; Kahn topological sort covers every face. Augmented matching has 7644 pairs and four critical 3-faces. Removing empty pair leaves 1 critical vertex and 4 critical 3-faces. By Forman, a CW complex with only those cells is a fourfold wedge of 3-spheres. The exact verifier in this package ran successfully, and the Euler characteristic is -3.

value.rationale: SG_{n,k} are vertex-critical chromatic examples and encode pairwise-intersecting cyclically stable families; the classification of their independence complexes is a motivated gap in Braun 2009. The natural SG_{3,3} equal-parameter case is the first instance with both parameters 3, not an arbitrary labeled subcomplex. Integral homotopy equivalence of a 9-dimensional 30-vertex complex to four 3-spheres gives a precise benchmark not implied by neighbor-family or neighborhood-complex results. The result is intentionally finite and complete; no larger theorem asserted.
